description: COSI driver cosi.ankra.cloud for Ankra Cloud object storage (S3 buckets from BucketClaims, keys from BucketAccesses).

Helm chart for the community Cloudflare Operator (adyanth/cloudflare-operator) that reconciles Tunnel, ClusterTunnel, AccessTunnel and TunnelBinding CRDs against Cloudflare Zero Trust / Cloudflare Tunnel. Optionally renders a ClusterOriginIssuer for use with the cert-manager origin-ca-issuer.
Kubernetes Gateway API CRDs (standard channel) as a small Helm chart, vendored unchanged from the upstream release. Kept on uninstall, so removing the release never deletes a route.
ISMS Builder on Kubernetes - the open-source ISO 27001 / NIS2 ISMS template builder, digest-pinned, non-root, persistent, network-restricted by default, with managed-secret guardrails.
Kamaji is the Hosted Control Plane Manager for Kubernetes.
